_doc: filter_radius: the engine's directional_shadow_quality_radius for each RenderingServer.ShadowQuality (renderer_scene_render_rd.cpp, tag 4.7.2-stable); cascades_a_side: four cascades share the map, two on each side (light_storage.cpp). Graphics presets and the frame cap applied by game/settings/settings.gd (frame_cap: Engine.max_fps while the game has the focus and while another application has it; 0 = no cap). shadow_size: the sun's atlas, a quarter per cascade; shadow_filter: RenderingServer.ShadowQuality: on a plain grey wall in half shadow the weave of the filter measured 8.9 at Soft Medium and 3.9 at Soft Ultra with daylight.json shadow_blur 0.6, for no GPU cost past the noise of the run (ports/landscape/relatorio.md).
